title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models in Infinitely Many Ways

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model vulnerability to generating racially discriminatory or hateful content (e.g., promoting white supremacy, claiming Black people are dangerous, or suggesting punishments for interracial marriage) by bypassing safety guardrails using cipher-encoded jailbreak prompts.
Testing whether models can be manipulated into agreeing with homophobic statements (e.g., claiming homosexuality is not natural) by using encoded jailbreak attacks to circumvent safety filters.
